props.description:
Data change set for 90 days by default, changes to the orders should only be initiated from the external ERP system or via other mechnisms and typically not done manually via Fuuz - however, if you do make manual changes, those changes will be tracked for 90 days unless this setting is modified.

Deleting an Order, will delete the line and release - providing no other transactions have been performed.

props.label: Business Partner
props.description: Short Abbreviated code for business partner - must be unique.

props.label: Product
props.description: A human-readable and unique shorthand name for the product

fields.label: Product
fields.description: Direct link to the product for which this Order Line applies. Note, that if creating an order type of sale - you may want to use this which specifically indicates the productId that must be shipped; alternatively, the Catalog Item can provide a method to suggest any 1 of {} the list of CatalogItemProducts maybe used to fulfil this order line. It is not recommended to use both fields - if you do, the shipping logic will not consider the Catalog Item, it will only consider the productId as validation.

fields.label: Business Partner Address
fields.description: This address is the deliver to address- for a sale, purchase or transfer order.

props.description: Order Line Releases are the individual ship/firm or plan schedules related to a single order number.

props.label: Actual Fulfilment At
props.description: The actual date, of the shipment or receipt based on order type. Should be compared to the shipAt for sales orders, or dueAt for purchase orders.

props.label: Ship At
props.description: Ship At date is generally determined by the Due At minus any transit time, this Ship At data is helpful in planning for shipping/picking activities.
